items.source: This variant records StartupStep as Flight Recorder events. Because such events only support base types, the StartupStep.Tags are serialized as a single String attribute.
items.translation: 此变体将 StartupStep 记录为 Flight Recorder 事件。由于此类事件仅支持基本类型，StartupStep.Tags 被序列化为单个 String 属性。

items.source: Once this is configured on the application context, you can record data by launching the application with recording enabled: java -XX:StartFlightRecording:filename=recording.jfr,duration=10s -jar app.jar.
items.translation:
配置完应用程序上下文后，您可以通过启用录制功能来启动应用程序以记录数据：
`java -XX:StartFlightRecording:filename=recording.jfr,duration=10s -jar app.jar`。
`start` 接口 `ApplicationStartup` 中

items.source:
A step name describes the current action or phase. This technical
name should be "." namespaced and can be reused to describe other instances of
the same step during application startup.
items.translation: 步骤名称描述当前操作或阶段。此技术名称应使用"."命名空间，并可在应用程序启动期间重复使用以描述同一步骤的其他实例。

items.source: Create a new step and marks its beginning.
items.translation: 创建新步骤并标记其开始。
